verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's Conditional Access page documents context-aware enforcement: access is revoked automatically when users are off a trusted network or their device falls out of compliance. That covers the network and device signals. The evidence is a single marketing-level statement and does not show location or risk-based conditions, or policies scoped per app and per group. Missing for 10: location/geo conditions, risk-signal-driven policies, per-app and per-group policy scoping, in-depth policy documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
